en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his predecessors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, “One who goes to a valley and   remembers   and   supplicates   the   Almighty   Allah spreading his hands, the Almighty Allah will fill the entire valley with goodness for every big and small thing present there.”
